P1.3.text: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals is a leading gastrointestinal (GI) healthcare company on a mission to advance the treatment of GI diseases and redefine the standard of care for GI patients.

P1.4.text: One in five Americans suffer from GI diseases, resulting in millions of hospital visits and tens of billions in healthcare costs each year.

data.offering_description: Holds royalty interests in respiratory medicines developed with partners and sells specialty antibiotics and a critical care drug to hospitals in the US. It earns royalty payments from partner drug sales and product sales to hospitals and wholesalers.

data.customer_segment: B2B: hospitals and drug wholesalers buying specialty drugs, pharmaceutical partners paying royalties

data.revenue_model: licensing or royalties: royalties on respiratory drugs sold by pharmaceutical partners; product sales: antibiotics and critical care drugs sold to hospitals

data.value_chain_position: brand owner: commercializes specialty hospital drugs, sold to hospitals and wholesalers; other: owns royalty interests in respiratory drugs made and sold by partners

data.geography_served: global: US hospitals for product sales, royalties on partner sales in many countries

data.specialization: related lines: respiratory drug royalty interests, hospital antibiotics, critical care drug

data.distribution_channels: distributors / dealers: drug wholesalers supplying hospitals; direct sales: specialty sales force calling on hospitals; other: royalty payments received from pharmaceutical partners

data.regulatory_exposure: high: FDA approval needed to sell drugs in the US, royalty revenue depends on partners' approvals

data.offering_description: Innoviva earns royalties from respiratory drugs partnered with GSK and markets its own critical care and infectious disease therapies to hospitals. It also holds a portfolio of equity and healthcare investments. Products are made by contract manufacturers and sold through wholesalers.

data.primary_products: respiratory inhaled therapies (royalty stream); antibiotics for hospital infections; critical care drugs for hypotension; oral antibiotic for gonorrhea

data.customer_segment: B2B: GSK as royalty payer, hospitals, pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors

data.end_markets: respiratory disease; critical care; infectious disease; hospitals

data.revenue_model: licensing or royalties: royalties on partner-sold respiratory products such as COPD and asthma inhalers; product sales: own critical care and anti-infective drugs sold to hospitals via wholesalers; other: gains and income from equity and long-term investments

data.value_chain_position: brand owner: markets specialty drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to hospitals and wholesalers; other: royalty holder collecting payments from GSK on licensed respiratory products

data.geography_served: global: royalties from worldwide partner sales, own products mainly in the US, with some international partnerships

data.specialization: related lines: royalty portfolio plus specialty critical care and infectious disease drugs, all pharmaceuticals

data.distribution_channels: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors supplying hospitals; direct sales: own hospital-focused commercial sales team; partners / resellers: GSK commercializes the royalty-bearing respiratory products

data.regulatory_exposure: high: prescription drugs requiring FDA approval and oversight, foreign regulators, healthcare pricing and reimbursement rules

P1.1.text: Innoviva – Healthcare Royalty and Asset Management

P1.2.text: Innoviva manages a respiratory royalty portfolio and makes strategic acquisitions in promising areas of unmet need, such as infectious diseases.

P1.3.text: Innoviva is fueling healthcare innovation by investing in areas of high unmet medical need as well as developing and commercializing differentiated therapies.

P1.4.text: We are a diversified biopharmaceutical company with a core royalties portfolio, a leading critical care and infectious disease platform, and a portfolio of strategic investments in healthcare assets.

P1.5.text: It’s who we are. It’s our purpose. It’s our passion. It’s why we exist. It’s our name. We are Innoviva.

P1.6.text: Strongly cashflow-positive, durable core royalty business stemming from widely used respiratory products

P1.7.text: Commercial stage, fast-growth critical care and infectious disease platform

P1.8.text: High-potential, valuable diversified portfolio of healthcare assets offers optionality, downside protection, and long-term value creation

P1.9.text: Thoughtful, robust approach to capital deployment with long-term horizon

P1.10.text: Strong track record and value creation focus

P2.2.text: Innoviva effectives manages royalty portfolio and advances innovation in areas of high unmet medical need.

P2.3.text: Long live the innovators. We’re here to help – through thoughtful capital allocation and stewardship.

P2.23.text: We believe in the power of partnership and inclusiveness, and that the best ideas can come from anywhere in the room. Together we are always better.

P2.24.text: We take the long view and focus our efforts.

P2.25.text: ACT WITH INTEGRITY, EVERY DAY IN EVERY WAY.

P2.26.text: We believe in transparency, honesty, and trust. A genuine desire to do what’s right will always be what defines us as a team and guides us on our journey.

P2.27.text: MAKE OUR MARK BY MAKING A DIFFERENCE.
